text:
alex: FYI started a small canary enabling our FP8 kernels for the 8k-long context run on model-eta. Seeing quality regressions and occasional NaNs on L40S nodes. posting quick summary + logs below. :frowning_face:

rachel: can you quantify the regression? perf numbers?

alex: eval PPL +6% vs fp16 baseline on our openbook dev set (8k). Rouge-L down ~2.4 points on abstractive subset. Not constant — looks sequence-length and batch-shape dependent. NaNs spike in attn_gemm path around step ~120 in the trace.

kevin: did you try forcing the FP8 saturation guard / scaling? I've seen activation clamp differences between h100 and l40s kernels.

alex: yes — toggled scaling_multiplier from 1.0->1.1 and saturation_clamp 12->16, small improvement but still worse than fp16. Also tested bias_correction toggles.

june: can you paste the canary config? especially fallback_policy and runtime flags.

alex: sure — here's the snippet I used for the canary:```yaml
runtime:
  enable_fp8: true
  fp8_variant: e4m3
  fp8_scaling_mode: dynamic
  activation_clip: 14.0
  saturation_guard: 1.15
  bias_correction: true
  fallback_policy:
    - kernel: attention_gemm_fp8
      on_nan: fallback_fp16
    - kernel: matmul_fp8
      on_perf_drop_pct: 10
```

samir: re: NaNs — sometimes FP8 AVX kernels on L40S run without the same per-layer rescale ordering we use on H100. Could be a compile-time kernel reorder bug. Do we have a build matrix to repro the exact kernel binary?

alex: built from release/2026-03-02 commit. repro command:```bash
python -m eval.run --model model-eta --seq-len 8192 --batch 1 --quant fp8 --seed 42 --device l40s
```

infra-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-12-08:15 pushed to pool: h100-us-east-1 (3 hosts), l40s-eu-central (2 hosts). Monitoring enabled. :rocket:

rachel: next steps I propose:
- collect full kernel traces (attn_gemm, matmul) + per-layer scales
- run same binary on H100 vs L40S to compare numerical diffs
- try the compat shim (sequential rescale) as temporary patch and rerun eval

kevin: also try disabling dynamic scaling and use static per-layer scale from calibration pass:```bash
python -m quant.calibrate --model model-eta --dataset smallcal --quant fp8 --out cal.json
# then run eval with --calibration cal.json```

june: if the fallback is triggering frequently we should reduce the canary traffic and revert to fp16 on L40S until we root-cause. We have alerts for quality delta > 3% on canary.

alex: agree — throttling canary to 10% on l40s and bumping to 50% on h100. attaching minimal logs:```
[attn_kernel] step=119 layer=17 status=nan_count=3 scale=0.000127 buffmax=1.4e+01
[matmul_fp8] perf=0.81x vs fp16
```

samir: quick thought: if activation distributions have heavier tails on longer contexts, fp8 e4m3 might hit saturation. AWQ/GPTQ experiments we ran earlier tolerated it because they did per-channel quant and better clip stats. Might need layerwise clip + fallback-policy that ramps to hybrid int8/fp16.

rachel: good point. let's run an AWQ-style per-channel calibration and compare accuracy. If AWQ/static-int8 keeps quality we can consider hybrid routing by model slice.

kevin: low-effort mitigation: enable on-the-fly prefix caching so we reduce long sequential runs on the kernel hot-path during canary — reduces exposure to tail activations.

alex: I will collect traces and run the calibration + AWQ pass. lowering canary on l40s now. will post results shortly. thanks all. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: canary throttle updated: l40s pool -> 10% traffic, h100 pool -> 50% traffic. Canary alerting: enabled.

june: if you need ops help to spin a debug build with extra symbol logging, ping me and I can do it within the next hour.

alex: pinged ops. attaching a short checklist for whoever picks this up:
- reproduce with the exact release binary on both H100 and L40S
- run quant.calibrate to produce static scales and rerun eval
- enable compat shim (sequential rescale) for attention_gemm
- collect per-layer activation histograms and NaN counts
- test AWQ per-channel quant config as backup

rachel: perfect. I'll coordinate the postmortem if this needs a rollback. keep notes in the canary ticket.

alex: logged findings in ticket RI-6032. will update when calibrations finish.
